messages:
Maria: opened a small PR to refresh the hello-spark quickstart (auth + first deploy). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/582 — need a reviewer and a link check.
Ben: on it, will scan the auth flow. did you test the token env var with SDK v4? @Alex any gotchas?
Alex: ran the snippet locally. one thing — env var should be REDWOOD_API_KEY not REDWOOD_KEY, i fixed that in the branch. also docker example missing port mapping.
Maria: awesome, thanks. Ben — CI is failing lint on that code sample, can you take a look?
Ben: saw the CI error — lint flagged deprecated fetch usage. switching sample to client.generate should fix it, pushing a commit now.
Ben: pushed commit 3f2b0 — replaced fetch with client.generate, and updated env var in examples.
ci-bot: CI: tests failed on commit 3f2a9 — lint error. waiting for new push.
ci-bot: CI: All checks passed :white_check_mark: on commit 3f2b0.
Natalie: i'll do a link sweep after merge. i spotted one broken sidebar link to "starter-app" and a dangling anchor on the deploy page.
Jason: can we add a short "what changed" note at the top of the quickstart for folks migrating from older SDK flags? should prevent confusion.
Maria: good call — added a one-liner about the deprecated flag and the new env var. @Natalie can you confirm the sidebar alias resolves post-merge?
Natalie: confirmed locally: getting-started/starter-app alias resolves to the updated quickstart. i'll open a tiny redirect PR to be safe, then run full link-sweep.
Alex: added a short comment in the code block about caching behavior and when to disable prefix cache for dev.
Maria: merging once CI stays green. plan: merge, then tag a docs patch release and deploy the site. ETA ~30m.
Ben: :rocket:

---

Code snippet from the PR (for reviewers):
```python
# old
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_KEY"])
# updated
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"])
```

Deploy note in the doc: `docker run -p 8080:8080 my-hello-spark` (added explicit port mapping)

Action items: Maria - merge & release; Ben - double-check sample outputs; Natalie - redirect + link sweep; Alex - follow-up tiny caching note.
